John Glasgow is named as father of the bride in the marriage index entry for Agnes Glasgow and Alexander Goodwin, 8 Jul 1825, Canongate, Edinburgh. <!-- record-father-william-glasgow-bengal-amelia: William Glasgow -->
[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
William Glasgow is named as father in five Bengal baptism index entries, four of them with a wife Amelia. William Glasgow born 6 Sep 1825 at Barrackpore, baptised 26 Jan 1826; father William, mother Amelia.<ref name="anc1271490">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9899/records/1271490 Ancestry India, Select Births and Baptisms, 1786-1947: William Glasgow, born 6 Sep 1825, Barrackpore, Bengal]. Ancestry index entry; original register uninspected.</ref> Amelia Magdalene Glasgow born 22 Nov 1830, baptised 27 Jul 1831 at Etawah; father William, mother Amelia.<ref name="anc362341">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9899/records/362341 Ancestry India, Select Births and Baptisms, 1786-1947: Amelia Magdalene Glasgow, born 22 Nov 1830, Etawah, Bengal]. Ancestry index entry; original register uninspected.</ref> Eliza Graves Glasgow born 5 Aug 1836, baptised 9 Oct 1836 at Serampore; father William, mother Amelia.<ref name="anc247030">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9899/records/247030 Ancestry India, Select Births and Baptisms, 1786-1947: Eliza Graves Glasgow, born 5 Aug 1836, Serampore, Bengal]. Ancestry index entry; original register uninspected.</ref> Harrietta Fordyce Glasgow born 11 Oct 1838 at Dehra; father William, mother Amelia.<ref name="anc794514">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9899/records/794514 Ancestry India, Select Births and Baptisms, 1786-1947: Harrietta Fordyce Glasgow, born 11 Oct 1838, Dehra, Bengal]. Ancestry index entry; original register uninspected.</ref> George Thomas James Dennis Glasgow born 6 Sep 1840, baptised 8 Oct 1842; father William (no mother named).<ref name="anc1390692">[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9899/records/1390692 Ancestry India, Select Births and Baptisms, 1786-1947: George Thomas James Dennis Glasgow, born 6 Sep 1840, baptised 8 Oct 1842, Bengal]. Ancestry index entry; original register uninspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
A2 father review, 2026-11-06: Named only as William Glasgow, father, with a wife Amelia, in Bengal baptisms at Barrackpore (1825), Etawah (1830), Serampore (1836), Dehra (1838) and an unplaced Bengal entry (1840, no mother named). Station-to-station moves of one family are the likely reading, but identity across the entries is a name-and-wife match. Identity hold.
